data.title: 诗怀雅 · 橱窗里的手袋
data.description: 她看了看橱窗里的手袋，先评价配色，再注意到旁边的设计说明，凑近读了起来。
data.promptProse: Outside a high-end fashion boutique, Swire stands before an illuminated display window, critically evaluating an avant-garde leather handbag poised on a black velvet pedestal. Polished brass trim and focused gallery spotlights reflect off the pristine plate glass.
data.animaCaption: Arms crossed with an appraising eye, she studies the artisan stitching on the handbag through the boutique glass with confident discernment.
